performance.verdict: Ads off for the full renewal period; GBP is the only active paid signal.

findings.text: Meta and Google Ads show $0 spend across all 28 days of the renewal window — no paid revenue, purchases, or ROAS data exists to evaluate.
Live-Cooking Shoot 1 was due 2026-08-14 and shows no completed event — 17 days overdue with no creative asset delivered.
GBP actions collapsed -84.42% last 7 days; last 3 days (Aug 28–30) show 0, 0, 0 actions vs prior 3-day average of ~8 — a confirmed zero, not noise.
GA4 sessions are directionally stable (last 3 days: 292, 273, 231 avg ~265) vs prior 3 (294, 335, 353 avg ~327) — a mild -19% softening with no paid driver to blame.
Purchases and revenue report $0 across all 28 days; Shopify pixel inconsistency flagged in SOW — data gap, not confirmed zero-sales, but unresolvable without Windsor reconciliation.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP listing immediately — 3 consecutive zero-action days (Aug 28–30) suggest suspension or suppression, not seasonality.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 on Aug 28, 29, and 30 — a confirmed 3-day zero after a -84.42% 7d drop. Check the listing for suspension, ownership conflicts, or a recent edit that triggered review. Success is confirmed when daily actions return above the Aug 1–21 average of ~18. Resolve by 2026-09-03.

suggestions.text: Escalate Live-Cooking Shoot 1 as a blocker — 17 days overdue; no creative pipeline means ads cannot launch.
suggestions.monday_update: Live-Cooking Shoot 1 was due 2026-08-14 and is 17 days overdue with no completed event recorded. Paid ads remain at $0 spend for the entire renewal period, making creative delivery the primary blocker to any revenue. Confirm a reschedule date with Haney and Ameer by 2026-09-03. Success is a locked shoot date on the calendar with assets delivered before the next review cycle.

suggestions.text: Watch GA4 session trend for 3 more days before attributing softening to anything — no paid traffic to explain the -19% 3-day dip.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 sessions averaged ~265 over the last 3 days vs ~327 in the prior 3 — a -19% dip with no active paid channel to explain it. This could be organic seasonality or a GBP suppression spillover. Re-check on 2026-09-03: if sessions remain below 250/day for 3 consecutive days, escalate as an organic visibility issue.
